templates.purpose: Confirms the user's e-mail address (new account, or after an admin changed the address); the signed link expires (default 60 minutes).

variables.brand_name: string — display name of the app the user is in (ventSSO's own for security alerts); may be absent
variables.brand_logo_url: string — https logo URL; absent when none is set
variables.brand_accent_color: string — #RRGGBB accent colour; absent when none is set
variables.brand_client_id: string — OAuth client id of the app the user is in; absent for ventSSO's own pages and always for security alerts
variables.locale: string — hu|en, the recipient's language (same as the template locale suffix)

templates.purpose: Security notice, branched on `event` inside the template. Always sent with ventSSO's own branding.

variables.minutes: int — account_locked only: the lock window in minutes
variables.provider: string — social_linked only: the linked provider (google|microsoft|apple)
variables.count: int — failed_per_minute / blocked_per_minute only: events counted in the last minute
variables.brand_name: string — display name of the app the user is in (ventSSO's own for security alerts); may be absent
variables.brand_logo_url: string — https logo URL; absent when none is set
variables.brand_accent_color: string — #RRGGBB accent colour; absent when none is set
variables.brand_client_id: string — OAuth client id of the app the user is in; absent for ventSSO's own pages and always for security alerts
variables.locale: string — hu|en, the recipient's language (same as the template locale suffix)

account_locked.purpose: The account was locked after too many failed sign-ins.

social_linked.purpose: A social sign-in provider was linked to the account.

failed_per_minute.purpose: Failed sign-ins per minute crossed the alert threshold.

blocked_per_minute.purpose: Blocked sign-ins per minute crossed the alert threshold.
